OFFICE MEMORANDUM

Sub.: 1. Decentralization of Revenue Recovery to District Level
2. Improving the delivery of services to the IPs.

The Director General has approved decentralization of
Revenue Recovery Oﬃces from Regional / Sub-Regional Oﬃces to
Branch Oﬃce so as to eﬀect the recovery and conclude the
Certiﬁcates issued by the Authorized Oﬃcers in time bound manner.
Accordingly, the Regional Directors and SRO-in-charges are required
to identify the Branch oﬃces where the recovery dues and
certiﬁcates are higher in number, and preferably only one in a
district so as to post the Recovery Officer in that Branch Office.

2. These Recovery Oﬃcer shall be designated as ‘Recovery
Oﬃcer-cum-Branch Manager’ and shall also be responsible for
managing the affairs of Branch Office and ensuring better delivery of
services to the beneﬁciaries, especially in relation to faster decision-
making process on the claims filed by the Insured Persons.

3. The Social Security Oﬃcer posted in the area for ‘Inspector-
cum-Facilitator’ functions shall also work as Recovery Inspector and
/or can function as Deputy Manager of the Branch Office, as the case
may be.

4. The Staﬀ posted in these Branch Oﬃces shall work for Revenue
Recovery Office also and additional staff to be posted, if so required.

5. The Recovery Oﬃcer posted in Regional Oﬃce or Sub-Regional
Oﬃce shall be the Coordinating Oﬃcer for these Recovery Oﬃcers
posted at districts for the Regional Director / Joint Director In-charge
in eﬀective implementing & monitoring mechanism/ reporting
system to the headquarters by the Regional Director and SRO In-
charges.

6. In the jurisdiction of Sub-Regional Oﬃces, consultation be
made with the SRO- in-charges by the Regional Directors for
exercising the powers for posting of Assistant Directors as Recovery
Officers at the location decided by the SRO-in-charge.

7. Implementation of this Oﬃce Memorandum be made in a
phased manner for smooth transition such that a Recovery Oﬃcer
should be able to execute 2-3 thousand certificates in a year.

This issues in consultation with FC / Personnel & Administration.

INSURANCE COMMISSIONER

To,
1. All Regional Directors/ SRO In-charges, ESI Corporation.
2. All Insurance Commissioners (Zones)/ NTA/HQ, ESIC.
3. PPS/ PS to DG/ FC/CVO/MC/CTO, ESIC HQ.
